title: Aberrant lncRNA–mRNA Expression Profile and Function Networks during the Adipogenesis of Mesenchymal Stem Cells from Patients with Ankylosing Spondylitis
description: We have already demonstrated that mesenchymal stem cells from patients with ankylosing spondylitis (ASMSCs) exhibited greater adipogenic differentiation potential than those from healthy donors (HDMSCs). Here, we further investigated the expression profile of long noncoding RNA (lncRNA) and mRNA, aiming to explore the underlying mechanism of abnormal adipogenic differentiation in ASMSCs. Overall design: HDMSCs and ASMSCs were separately isolated and induced with adipogenic differentiation medium for 10 days. Thereafter, lncRNAs and mRNAs that were differentially expressed (DE) between HDMSCs and ASMSCs were identified via high-throughput sequencing
